chat_decision_checkpoint.implementation_context: existing local GserverStorage hierarchy read only

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'GSERVER_G_STORAGE_DIRS:\n'
find /mnt/g/GserverStorage -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 2 -type d -printf '%P\n' 2>/dev/null | head -90
printf 'GSERVER_G_STORAGE_WRITEABLE='
test -w /mnt/g/GserverStorage && echo YES || echo NO
printf 'GSERVER_G_STORAGE_DISK='
df -h /mnt/g/GserverStorage | tail -1 | awk '{print $2,$3,$4,$5}'
